items.title: 10 new workouts, easy to find
items.body: Push power, Pull strength, Posterior chain, Dumbbell full body, Bodyweight anywhere, Machine starter, Core crusher, HIIT circuit, Climber's strength and Mobility reset. Explore → Workouts has goal chips and a search by name, muscle or goal.

items.title: Training programmes
items.body: Explore → Programmes: Strength foundation (8 weeks), Muscle builder (6) and Climber's power (6). A programme runs your plan in phases with signature workouts and ends with a PR test. Pause it any time; your own plan comes back.

items.title: See each style before you pick
items.body: Account → Style: swipe through the styles, each with its real iPhone and Watch screens, then tap Use to switch.

items.title: Fluid motion, every exercise
items.body: Fast moves like burpees, swings and twists now play with up to 49 poses, so nothing jumps. Every animation was checked again: hands stay on the bar, bodies sit on the bench and limbs no longer pass through machines.

items.title: Safer account: passkeys and 2-step
items.body: Password, email and account changes now ask you to confirm it's you first. Account → Security: add a passkey to sign in with Face ID, or turn on 2-step codes from an authenticator app. Apple and passkeys skip 2-step.
